proposal.chemistry_notes: Thermal Knoevenagel condensation. Acetic acid acts as both solvent and acid catalyst. Reaction is moisture sensitive due to DMF-DMA acetal stability. Single stream simplifies setup. No photochemistry involved. BPR required to maintain liquid phase at 80°C in acetic acid (bp 118°C) and ensure safety margin.

batch_record.reaction_description: combined methyl 4-methoxyacetoacetate with dimethylformamide dimethylacetal in acetic acid
batch_record.raw_text: The first operation of a seven-step sequence combined methyl 4-methoxyacetoacetate (2.0 mmol, 1.0 equiv) with dimethylformamide dimethylacetal (1.6 equiv) in acetic acid at 0.20 M. The batch operation was heated at 80 C for 60 min and furnished the vinylogous amide intermediate in 96% yield. The requested design objective is an integrated, staged continuous process through the reported dolutegravir sequence, with explicit residence time and additions for every stage.
